Name: aDash
Comment: Status block read by the dashboard

Name: aCmd
Comment: Command block written by the dashboard (only when drive control is on)

Name: aSIG300_In
Comment: Copy of the SIG300 input assembly (00_IO_Map)

Name: xMPB_PortActive
Comment: Port S1 has a working IO-Link device

Name: xMPB_DataOK
Comment: MPB10 values are valid this scan

Name: iPD_Ofs
Comment: Offset of port S1 process data in aSIG300_In (6, from the SIG300 EDS)

Name: wMPB_Alarm
Comment: MPB10 status word, raw (process data bytes 18-19)

Name: rVibVelocity
Comment: Vibration velocity RMS, the worst axis, mm/s

Name: aMPB_Value
Comment: The MPB10's four floats: temperature, X, Y, Z

Name: xSensorCommAlarm
Comment: Sensor data not reaching the PLC

Name: xDemoEnable
Comment: Bench enable, set from an animation table. FALSE = drive never gets a run command

Name: xRing_Closed
Comment: RIO main ring redundant: both paths OK (00_IO_Map)

Name: xRingDiagMapped
Comment: TRUE: xRing_Closed is mapped, so the dashboard shows ring status

Name: iRunSource
Comment: Who started the motor: 0 none, 2 dashboard, 3 animation table

Name: xLampGreen
Comment: Stack light green (shown on the dashboard): running

Name: xLampAmber
Comment: Stack light amber (shown on the dashboard): warning

Name: xLampRed
Comment: Stack light red: alarm / fault, blinking = no sensor data

Name: wDashPanel
Comment: RIO, enable and stack-light bits for the dashboard (aDash[29])

Name: xDashboardAllowed
Comment: PLC-side permission for the dashboard to run the motor

Name: iAccDefault
Comment: Accel ramp when the dashboard is not in control, s x10

Name: iDecDefault
Comment: Decel ramp when the dashboard is not in control, s x10

Name: iATV_Acc
Comment: Accel ramp sent to the drive (ACC), s x10

Name: iATV_Dec
Comment: Decel ramp sent to the drive (DEC), s x10

Name: xLocalRun
Comment: Commissioning: run from the animation table

Name: xSimBridge
Comment: Testing only: drive values from drive_bridge.py (PLC simulator). FALSE on the real M580

Name: aBridge
Comment: Drive bridge block (drive_bridge.py writes 0-7, the PLC writes 8)

Name: iATV_SpeedRef
Comment: Speed reference to the drive (LFRD), rpm

Name: wDashStatus
Comment: Sensor status bits for the dashboard

Name: wDashDrive
Comment: Drive status bits for the dashboard

Name: aAlm
Comment: Alarm block: status, raised times and history (06_Alarms)

Name: aAlmCmd
Comment: Alarm commands: [0] acknowledge bits, [1] 1 = clear history

Name: aAlmState
Comment: 0 normal, 1 active, 2 active acknowledged, 3 cleared not acknowledged

Name: xAlmNow
Comment: This alarm's condition after the on-delay

Name: iAlmType
Comment: Event this scan: 1 raised, 2 cleared, 3 acknowledged
